title: Repair cafe booking change
brief:
Draft a public notice for visitors to the Birch Room Mending Café about a booking change for its April 18 session. The event runs from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. at Birch Hall and covers simple clothing repairs, including loose buttons, split seams, and small holes. Visitors can reserve one free 20-minute slot in person at the hall desk from April 6 through April 16. Three slots are held for walk-ins and assigned from 10 a.m. in arrival order. Each visitor may bring one clean garment. The notice will be pinned outside the hall and should explain both ways to get a slot.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

**Birch Room Mending Café — Booking change for April 18**

Join us at Birch Hall on April 18 from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. for help with simple clothing repairs, including loose buttons, split seams, and small holes. Each visitor may bring one clean garment.

There are two ways to get a free 20-minute slot.

- **Book ahead.** Visit the Birch Hall desk in person from April 6 through April 16 to reserve one slot.
- **Walk in on April 18.** Three slots are held for walk-ins. We’ll assign them starting at 10 a.m., in the order visitors arrive.

# Birch Room Mending Café
## April 18 booking change

Join us at Birch Hall on April 18, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., for help with simple clothing repairs such as loose buttons, split seams, and small holes. Each visitor may bring one clean garment.

**Reserve a slot in advance.** Visit the hall desk in person from April 6 through April 16 to reserve one free 20-minute slot.

**Come as a walk-in.** Three slots are held for visitors without a reservation. We’ll assign them in order of arrival, starting at 10 a.m. on April 18.
